settings.hero_lede: Three generations have built Gift Palace into a sanctuary for certified gemstones, intentional jewellery, and pieces that carry meaning.
settings.story_body: Our atelier began in Delhi with a small set of gemstones and a question: can a piece of jewellery actually hold meaning? Decades later, that question still guides us — through every stone we cut, every setting we finish, and every gift we wrap.
settings.atelier_heading: How a Gift Palace piece is made
settings.cta_lede: Choose what feels right — by stone, by intention, or by the person you are gifting.

settings.heading: Certified provenance
settings.body: Every gemstone is lab-tested. Every piece is BIS hallmarked. No grey areas — just paperwork that travels with your gift.

settings.heading: Crafted by hand
settings.body: Our setters and karigars have built these pieces for decades. Each setting is finished by a human, not a machine line.

settings.heading: Cared for after
settings.body: Sizing, cleaning, repolishing, restringing — for the life of the piece. Drop in or send it back; we will look after it.

settings.heading: Source
settings.body: Stones sourced through GJEPC-verified channels and inspected before they enter the atelier.

settings.heading: Cut
settings.body: Master cutters shape each piece to maximise brilliance while preserving carat.

settings.heading: Set
settings.body: Hand-set by karigars trained over years — every prong, bezel, and channel finished individually.

settings.heading: Certify
settings.body: Every finished piece is documented and shipped with its certificate of authenticity.
